true_json.Title: U.S. Individual Income Tax Return

required: Your first name and middle initial
If joint return, spouse’s first name and middle initial
Filing Status — Married filing jointly (even if only one had income)
Filing Status — If you checked the MFS box, enter the name of your spouse. If you checked the HOH or QSS box, enter the child’s name if the qualifying person is a child but not your dependent
Filing Status — If treating a nonresident alien or dual-status alien spouse as a U.S. resident for the entire tax year, check the box
Filing Status — Nonresident alien or dual-status alien spouse — enter their name
Standard Deduction — Someone can claim: You as a dependent
Standard Deduction — Someone can claim: Your spouse as a dependent
Standard Deduction — Spouse itemizes on a separate return or you were a dual-status alien
Age/Blindness — You: Were born before January 2, 1960
Age/Blindness — Spouse: Was born before January 2, 1960
Dependents — If more than four dependents, see instructions and check here
1a — Total amount from Form(s) W-2, box 1 (see instructions)
1b — Household employee wages not reported on Form(s) W-2
1c — Tip income not reported on line 1a (see instructions)
1d — Medicaid waiver payments not reported on Form(s) W-2 (see instructions)
1e — Taxable dependent care benefits from Form 2441, line 26
1f — Employer-provided adoption benefits from Form 8839, line 29
6c — If you elect to use the lump-sum election method, check here (see instructions)
7 — Attach Schedule D if required. If not required, check here
9 — Add lines 1z, 2b, 3b, 4b, 5b, 6b, 7, and 8. This is your total income
10 — Adjustments to income from Schedule 1, line 26
11 — Subtract line 10 from line 9. This is your adjusted gross income
12 — Standard deduction or itemized deductions (from Schedule A)
13 — Qualified business income deduction from Form 8995 or Form 8995-A
15 — Subtract line 14 from line 11. If zero or less, enter -0-. This is your taxable income

notes: Fresh direct image extraction; human-review proposal. Covers the visible first page of Form 1040, including blank form fields and unchecked choices. General instruction prose is not separately transcribed. Values are transcribed as printed without tax calculations.
approval_note: User accepted these fresh extractions as the shared KV/schema references. Flagged uncertainties remain excluded from both pending correction.

b.description: Household employee wages not reported on Form W-2.

e.description: Taxable dependent care benefits from Form 2441.

c.description: Whether the taxpayer elected to use the lump sum election method. Return false unless box is checked.

spouseSsn.description: Spouse social security number. Return in the following format: 123-45-6789

spouseFirstName.description: Spouse first name. Exclude middle initial

address1.description: Address line one. Excludes Suites / Apartment numbers.

taxYearEnd.description: Last 2 digits of the tax year (ex: 22)

taxDateStart.description: Month and day tax year start (ex: 1/01)

ssn.description: Dependent social security number. Return in the following format: 123-45-6789

otherCredit.description: Does the dependent qualify for other credit. Return false unless box is checked

childTaxCredit.description: Does the dependent qualify for child tax credit. Return false unless box is checked

dependents.description: List of dependents and their information. Return null if there are no dependents.

blind.description: Taxpayer is blind. Return false unless box is checked.

spouseBlind.description: Spouse is blind. Return false unless box is checked.

bornBeforeJanuary.description: Taxpayer born before January 2, 1960. Return false unless box is checked.

spouseBornBeforeJanuary.description: Spouse born before January 2, 1960. Return false unless box is checked.

ageBlindness.description: Taxpayer and Spouse age and blindess classification.

HOH.description: Head of household. Return false unless box is checked.

MFJ.description: Married filing jointly. Return false unless box is checked.

MFS.description: Married filing separately. Return false unless box is checked.

QSS.description: Qualifying surviving spouse. Return false unless box is checked.

single.description: Single. Return false unless box is checked.

nonResident.description: If treating a nonresident alien or dual-status alien spouse as a U.S. resident for the entire tax year. Return false unless box is checked.

ssn.description: Primary social security number. Always return in the following format: 123-45-6789

firstName.description: Taxpayer first name. Exclude middle initial.

spouseItemizes.description: Spouse itemizes on a separate return. Return false unless box is checked.

youAreDependent.description: Someone can claim you as a dependent. Return false unless box is checked.

spouseIsDependent.description: Someone can claim your spouse as a dependent. Return false unless box is checked.
